notes.title: April 9, 2021: Tutorial Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the tutorial wouldn't start properly.

notes.title: April 4, 2021 Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed issues related to the Retry feature.

Fixed artifact effects being duplicated on retry
Fixed an issue that prevented retries from being used
Fixed another issue that allowed retries to be used indefinitely.

notes.title: March 31, 2021 Patch: Retries Added
notes.notes:
New Stuff

Replay a match after you are defeated.  You get a free retry that will allow you to move past your defeat, but after you use that, replaying will only let you experiment to see how you could have played an encounter differently (your run will still be over).
3 new Artifacts: "Emergency Camouflage", "Immovable Assault", and "Heroic Magnitude".
2 new Items: "Shielding Augment" and "Balanced Augment".

Changes

Replaced the +1 deploy point unlocks with +1 retry unlocks. You will have 5 points now by default.
Changed the "Evade and Blade" Artifact.  It now applies blind to enemies when they damage your units as well.
The "Mystical Studies" Artifact has been replaced with "Mystical Force", which causes your mystics to deal their attack damage to all enemies in their attack range.
The "Pillaging" Artifact now causes soldiers to apply "Incinerate" and gives you extra credits when enemies die with incinerate active on them.
The "Concentrated Fire" Artifact now causes rangers to make their targets take 33% more damage every time they attack (stacking indefinitely).
"The Sage" Hero's ability that provides additional actions is now capped at 3 per turn.

notes.title: March 23, 2021 Patch
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Stalemating a boss no longer counts as a victory, unless you have the "Patience" artifact.
Invalid deploy placement of 2+ space units fixed.
Fixed "The Sage of Prosperity"'s ability not causing allies to gain energy.


Balance

Orthodoxy unit health reduced.
Chosen Cathar's bonus damage per point of Immortal Seed reduced from 100 to 25.
Vestal of Apotheosis' damage reduced from 25(+25 vs light)x2 to 30.
Vestal of Apotheosis no longer has Haste.
Difficulty of +2 and +3 random encounters increased.

notes.title: Tutorial Patch
notes.notes:
Added a more in-depth tutorial.
Revised health bar to make energy more clearly connected to abilities
Added effects when equipping items to units
Revised a few misleading item icons
Fixed "Flash Core" item not triggering properly.
Fixed issue with neophytes spawning on top of each other in the final boss fight
